skill.name: hono-jsx
skill.description: Use when building UI for a Hono app with hono/jsx — pages, layouts, forms, and interactive parts — server-rendered with jsxRenderer, developed and built with Vite, with client components via hono/jsx/dom. TRIGGER when tsconfig has jsxImportSource "hono/jsx", code imports 'hono/jsx', 'hono/jsx/dom', 'hono/jsx-renderer' or 'vite-ssr-components', or the user asks for a page, screen, layout, or form in a Hono project. Never reach for React.
skill.summary: Build server-rendered Hono interfaces with reusable layouts, validated forms, Vite assets, and focused client interactivity.
skill.author: honojs

content.user_title: Build Hono JSX Pages and Interactive Interfaces
content.value_statement: Hono interfaces need consistent layouts, asset handling, and clear boundaries between server and browser code. This skill guides server-rendered pages, form workflows, and focused client components without React.
actual_capabilities: Guide Cloudflare Workers project setup with Hono JSX, Vite plugins, generated binding types, and asset components.
Define shared and nested layouts with jsxRenderer, typed layout properties, and page metadata.
Structure HTML form submissions with Hono routes, validation guidance, error rendering, and redirects.
Add browser behavior through plain DOM scripts or stateful hono/jsx/dom components.
Explain stylesheet integration, component-scoped CSS, trusted HTML handling, and experimental streaming.
Provide alternative Vite build patterns for Node and other supported runtimes.
limitations: Provides a single instruction document, not bundled application code, automated tests, or an executable generator.
Targets Hono JSX rather than React applications or React component libraries.
Refers to a separate hono skill for CLI usage, validation details, and broader framework guidance.
Client components mount without hydration; streaming APIs are experimental and require careful evaluation.

use_cases.title: Create a Workers Interface
use_cases.description: Add server-rendered pages, shared navigation, and managed Vite assets to a Cloudflare Workers application.
use_cases.target_user: Backend developers building a web interface

use_cases.title: Build Accessible Form Workflows
use_cases.description: Create HTML forms with server validation, visible errors, and redirects while keeping core tasks usable without client JavaScript.

use_cases.title: Review Hono Frontend Architecture
use_cases.description: Check rendering boundaries, runtime configuration, binding types, and client asset delivery across an existing Hono project.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a server-rendered home page to my Hono app using hono/jsx and jsxRenderer. Reuse the existing project structure and avoid React.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Validated Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Hono todo page with an HTML form. Validate submissions, preserve entered values on errors, and redirect after successful creation.

prompt_templates.title: Add Focused Client State
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a stateful counter using hono/jsx/dom. Keep page content server-rendered, load browser assets through Vite, and include correct client TypeScript references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: separate server and browser behavior

prompt_templates.title: Review Rendering and Builds
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Hono JSX app for nested layout typing, binding type generation, Vite asset handling, and runtime-specific builds. Assess streaming only for slow data.

output_examples.input: How should I add a shared layout to my Hono pages?
output: Define the document structure and shared navigation in jsxRenderer.
Render each page through its Hono route and pass typed layout properties when needed.
Use the Hono Vite asset components for development and production assets.

output_examples.input: My form needs to work before browser scripts load.
output: Use an HTML form that posts to a Hono route.
Validate the submitted fields and render the page again with errors when validation fails.
Redirect to the listing page after a successful mutation.

output_examples.input: Can I make one page section interactive without React?
output: Use a plain DOM script for simple behavior or a hono/jsx/dom component for stateful rendering.
Mount the component into a dedicated container; it remains empty until its browser script runs.

best_practices: Keep core content server-rendered and add browser state only where the interface requires it.
Validate form input on the server and never pass untrusted input to raw HTML APIs.
Generate runtime binding types and verify routes, typechecking, and production asset paths in the existing project.
anti_patterns: Adding React dependencies or React-specific Vite plugins to a Hono JSX application.
Moving essential page content into client-only containers that remain empty without JavaScript.
Bypassing managed Vite asset components on Cloudflare or manually inventing runtime binding types.

faq.question: Does this skill require React?
faq.answer: No. It targets hono/jsx and explicitly avoids React dependencies, React imports, and React-specific Vite plugins.

faq.question: Which development tools can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools. The guidance applies to Hono JSX projects.

faq.question: Does it support runtimes beyond Cloudflare Workers?
faq.answer: Yes. Cloudflare Workers is the default, with additional Vite build guidance for Node and other runtime adapters.

faq.question: Do forms require client JavaScript?
faq.answer: No. The recommended workflow uses HTML forms, Hono POST routes, server validation, and redirects.

faq.question: Do client components hydrate server markup?
faq.answer: No. The documented approach mounts client components into empty containers. Keep essential content server-rendered.

faq.question: Can I use streaming for every page?
faq.answer: The skill recommends streaming only for genuinely slow data. It identifies Suspense and ErrorBoundary as experimental APIs.
